notes.title: v 5.2 Patch Note
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35193028/58d1cb8d1208d6f1ec0570b596c1024a9d2753d1.jpg
Fixed an intermittent reconnection error when starting the game.
Fixed an issue where the left and right buttons were displayed in reverse in the body part UI.
Now instead of the mouse button, you can use the Z/x keys.
Intro progress has been accelerated.
The launch icon has been replaced.
